meta.title: TLab
meta.description: TLab is a small Thai crew that builds software for fun, and to fix everyday Thai problems nobody has gotten around to yet.

hero.title: We build software for fun.
hero.lead: TLab is a small Thai crew. We make software for the fun of it, and to fix the everyday Thai problems nobody has gotten around to yet.

what.title: We find everyday problems and build small things to fix them.

items.title: Spot the gap
items.body: We look for corners of Thai life the big platforms skip, especially the ones starting to grow.

items.title: One thing at a time
items.body: One simple product at a time. We ship early, listen, and tweak.

items.title: Made for here
items.body: Thai language, LINE, PromptPay. The stuff people here actually use.

exploring.title: What we're building
exploring.noteBefore: Got a problem we should look at?
exploring.lead: Two things on our bench right now. Both are in development, with nothing to try yet.

projects.name: Maa Laew
projects.body: Show up, check in, keep the streak. Run and training clubs in Bangkok, all in one calendar.

projects.name: Toh
projects.body: Book a table with friends and split the deposit. The table's yours when everyone's paid.

items.title: Talk first
items.body: We chat with the people who live the problem before writing any code.

items.title: Stay small
items.body: If a feature doesn't help the main thing, it can wait.

items.title: Keep it plain
items.body: Clear prices, no jargon. We take your data seriously (PDPA, done properly).

contact.title: Say hi
contact.lead: Whether you run a brand, a community or a team, or you're just curious, drop us a line. We like meeting new people.

meta.title: Got a problem? | TLab
meta.description: Tell TLab about an everyday Thai problem that annoys you. No name needed. We read what you send when we pick what to look at next.

problem.title: Got a problem?
problem.lead: Something in everyday Thai life that's annoying, clunky or just missing? Tell us. You don't need to be polite or precise, and you don't need to leave your name.

problem.label: The problem
problem.hint: What's annoying you? Tell us like you'd tell a friend. Please leave out other people's names and phone numbers.

who.label: Who has this problem?
who.hint: Me, my friends, my shop, my club…

today.label: How do you deal with it today?

category.label: What's it about?
category.hint: Pick any that fit, or none.

follow.label: Can we follow up?
follow.hint: Totally optional. Skip it and we'll still read your problem.

consent.label: OK, TLab can keep my contact details to follow up about this problem.
consent.hint: Needed only if you leave a nickname, email or LINE ID.
consent.collect: The problem you write, any optional answers, and the contact details you choose to add.
consent.why: To understand the problem, and to follow up with you if you left contact details.
consent.rightsBefore: Want to see it, correct it or delete it? You can also take back your OK any time. Email
consent.reviewNote: [Consent text: pending founder or counsel review]

errors.summary: Almost there. A couple of things to fix:
errors.problemRequired: Tell us the problem first. Even a sentence helps.
errors.emailInvalid: That email doesn't look right. Check it or leave it blank.
errors.consentRequired: Tick the box so we can keep your contact details, or clear the contact fields to stay anonymous.

failed.title: That didn't go through.
failed.body: Our form hiccuped. What you wrote is still on your screen. You can email it to us instead:

success.title: Thanks, got it!
success.body: Your problem is in the pile we look through when we pick what to try next. If you left contact details, we might get in touch.
